resources.string: Show your Mac’s Fremkit dashboard on this tablet.
The saved pairing could not be read. Pairing again replaces it.
Check that it is on, on the same network, and that “Allow a tablet on the local network” is turned on in Fremkit.
This tablet is no longer allowed
It was removed on the Mac. Pair it again to show the dashboard.
If you reset its certificate in Fremkit, pair this tablet again. Otherwise, check you are on the right network.
Fremkit needs Android System WebView 82 or later to show the dashboard. This tablet has version %1$s.
Fremkit needs Android System WebView 82 or later to show the dashboard.
Fremkit on the Mac is older than this app: update it.
This app is older than Fremkit on the Mac: update it from Fremkit’s releases page.
This is not the Mac that showed the code
The Mac did not accept the request. Update Fremkit on the Mac.
The Mac is not showing a pairing code any more. Make a new one in Fremkit and scan it.
The pairing could not be saved on this tablet.
This tablet will show the dashboard of %1$s instead.
Another app opened a pairing link for %1$s (%2$s). Pair only with your own Mac: it will choose what this tablet shows.
Point the camera at the code the Mac shows.
No Mac found yet. In Fremkit on the Mac, turn on “Allow a tablet on the local network” (Screen tab).
Check that the Mac shows the same words.
Screen pinning must be turned on in the system settings (Security). To leave a pinned app, use the system’s gesture: on most tablets, touch and hold Back and Overview.
This tablet will stop showing its dashboard and will have to be paired again.
